ideal: Each Space Peak change is a small signed-off pull request of 200 lines or fewer, in a table, reviewed and merged by the orchestrator.

sources.title: GitHub Docs: Helping others review your changes

quality: Green at its head, with its own test, sign-off and issue link; never pushed to main.
speed: Merged within the hour of going green.
consumption: Few pushes per change, each running one short CI job.
